Radar letadel, počasí a cena elektřiny n: Aircraft radar, weather and electricity price on your desk
Malý kulatý displej ukazuje letadla, kte: A small round display shows the aircraft flying past your house right now, with airline logo and route. Plus a forecast that warns you before it starts raining, the animated ČHMI weather radar, the spot electricity price and a clock with name days. It is set up from your phone, speaks Czech, English, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish and Vietnamese, and downloads new versions from GitHub by itself.

Deska ESP32-C3 má vestavěnou WiFi. Přes: The ESP32-C3 board has built-in WiFi. It asks several free online services for data and draws the result on the display. You reach it from your phone through a web page that the board serves itself.

Displej se překresluje několikrát za sek: The display is redrawn several times a second from the most recently downloaded data. Downloads run separately, so the display never freezes while loading.
Když v hotspotu 5 minut nikdo nic nenast: If nobody changes anything in the hotspot for 5 minutes and a WiFi network is already saved, the device restarts and tries it again (for example when the router was only off for a while).
Letadla vysílají na 1090 MHz polohu, výš: Aircraft broadcast their position, altitude, speed, track and callsign on 1090 MHz. Thousands of volunteers receive this at home with a cheap receiver (antenna + RTL-SDR) and share it with the community aggregators adsb.fi and adsb.lol. The device mainly asks adsb.fi; adsb.lol is the backup because without a key it only allows 500 requests a day. If you have your own receiver (e.g. adsb-feeder), the device can read the aircraft directly from it.
Zařízení se jich ptá „letadla v okruhu X: The device asks for “aircraft within X km around me”. It computes the distance and direction of each one and draws them on the radar: the centre is your house, north is up. The data is not filtered, so military and private aircraft are visible too.
ČHMI zveřejňuje <a href=\"https://openda: ČHMI (the Czech weather service) publishes open data: for each station a daily file with all 10-minute measurements. It is hundreds of kB, more than the board’s free memory.
Zařízení ho proto čte postupně. U každé: So the device reads it bit by bit. For each quantity it keeps only the latest value and adds up the day’s precipitation. Pressure is converted to sea level so it matches the numbers in forecasts.
Každých 5 minut stáhne posledních 6 sním: Every 5 minutes it downloads the last 6 radar images, crops them to the area around your home and plays them as an animation on an outline map (borders, rivers, cities).
Porovnáním snímků zjistí, kam a jak rych: By comparing the images it works out where and how fast the precipitation is moving and calculates when it will reach you or when the rain will stop. The radar shows reality, so it takes priority over the model forecast.
<a href=\"https://open-meteo.com\" targe: Open-Meteo provides the output of weather models (for Central Europe mainly ICON from the German DWD). The device takes the current conditions, precipitation in 15-minute steps for 2 hours and the hourly forecast.
Z nich počítá upozornění: mráz, náledí,: From these it computes alerts: frost, black ice, strong wind, thunderstorms, snow and heat.
ADS-B nevysílá, odkud a kam letadlo letí: ADS-B does not say where an aircraft is flying from and to. The device therefore looks the route up by callsign in the community databases adsb.lol (checked against the aircraft’s position) and adsbdb.com.
Logo společnosti podle ICAO kódu (CSA123: The airline logo is chosen by ICAO code (CSA123 → Czech Airlines) and downloaded from a public collection on GitHub.
Výsledky denního trhu <a href=\"https://: Day-ahead market results of OTE (the Czech market operator) in 15-minute steps, in Czech crowns, via spotovaelektrina.cz or spotovky.cz. You choose the source in the settings; if it fails, the other one is used automatically. OTE publishes tomorrow’s prices around 13:00.
Without any setup it is the bare exchange price. In the web settings you can add fees and VAT.

When something does not work, you can see why there.
Není potřeba nic dělat. Zařízení se na G: There is nothing you need to do. The device checks GitHub a minute after power-on and then once a day. When it finds a newer version, it restarts first and downloads it right after boot, while the memory is free. The display shows “Update” with a percentage and then restarts into the new version.
GitHub stažení přesměrovává na jiný serv: GitHub redirects the download to another server. The device finds the target address itself and closes the first connection, so it only ever has one encrypted connection open. If the download fails, it tries up to three times. During the update the web interface only answers with a short “Updating…” page.
Paměť má dva oddíly pro program a nová v: The memory has two program partitions and the new version is written to the one that is not running. If the download is interrupted (WiFi or power outage), the old version keeps running and the device does not break.
Automatické aktualizace se dají vypnout: Automatic updates can be turned off in the web settings. There is also a button “Check and install the latest version”.
O sestavení a vydání se stará GitHub Act: GitHub Actions takes care of building and releasing. You only need to raise the version number.
Udělej změny ve firmwaru a pushni je do: Make your changes to the firmware and push them to the main branch. Every push is built automatically, so errors show up right away.
V souboru <code>VERSION</code> zvyš čísl: Raise the number in the VERSION file, e.g. from 0.1.2 to 0.2.0, and push. You can also do it directly in the editor on the GitHub website (pencil icon).
GitHub Actions přeloží firmware a vytvoř: GitHub Actions builds the firmware and creates Release v0.2.0 with three files: firmware.bin (for OTA), firmware-full.bin (for USB) and esp32-stand-system-arduino-v0.2.0.zip (sources for the Arduino IDE with the version included). It takes about two minutes.
Zařízení si novou verzi stáhne při nejbl: Devices download the new version at their next daily check. To install it right away, restart the device or use the button in the web settings.
<b>Podmínky:</b> repozitář musí být veře: Requirements: the repository must be public, because the device connects to GitHub without a password. The version number must always go up.
Na displeji je QR kód, ale telefon WiFi: The display shows a QR code, but the phone cannot see the “Letadla-XXXX” WiFi
Známá vada ESP32-C3 Super Mini: kvůli šp: A known flaw of the ESP32-C3 Super Mini: because of a poor antenna the hotspot does not transmit at full power. Since v0.1.1 the power is reduced. Flash the latest firmware-full.bin over USB. Sometimes it also helps to bring the phone closer or hold a finger near the antenna on the board.
Zařízení se nepřipojí k domácí WiFi: The device does not connect to the home WiFi
Po třech neúspěšných pokusech (asi minut: After three failed attempts (about a minute) it switches to the hotspot by itself. Check the password and that the network uses the 2.4 GHz band, because the ESP32 does not support 5 GHz.
Na radaru je „HTTP 426“ nebo jiná chyba: The radar shows “HTTP 426” or another ADS-B error
Chybu 426 opravuje verze v0.1.2. U jinýc: Error 426 is fixed in v0.1.2. For other codes the message tells you which API failed. The device automatically tries the other one. If both fail, it is usually a temporary outage of the service.
Meteoradar nebo loga hlásí „málo RAM“, n: Weather radar or logos report “low RAM” or do not show up
Každé šifrované spojení potřebuje asi 45: Every encrypted connection needs about 45 kB of RAM and the ESP32-C3 has little of it. Since v0.6.5 the memory is arranged so that it is enough. Install the latest version. On the System page watch the RAM minimum: above roughly 15 kB everything is fine.
GitHub přesměrovává stažení na jiný serv: GitHub redirects the download to another server, and older versions briefly needed memory for two encrypted connections at once. Since v0.14.2 the device resolves the redirect itself and always has only one connection open. If you have an older version and the update fails, close the System page in the browser and try again. If that does not help, flash firmware-full.bin over USB once. Further updates will then work over WiFi.
U letadla se nezobrazuje logo nebo trasa: An aircraft shows no logo or route
Obojí funguje jen u letů leteckých spole: Both only work for airline flights. The callsign must be 3 letters and a number, e.g. CSA2LK. Private aircraft broadcast their registration (OKNEB) and there is no logo or route for them. Routes are looked up in community databases and are sometimes missing for charter and cargo flights. A question mark before the route means it does not match the aircraft’s position. The result of the last lookup is on the System page.
Server s letovými daty hlásí, že od tvé: The flight data server reports that it received too many requests from your IP address (429; other devices on the same network count too), or refused access (403). The device skips that server for 1–10 minutes, tries the other one and meanwhile shows the last known aircraft. The error disappears by itself as soon as data is downloaded again.
Na stránce Systém je v řádku ADS-B vidět: The System page shows the source and the error in the ADS-B row. Try opening http://receiver-IP:8080/data/aircraft.json in the browser – it must show text with a list of aircraft. If not, find the right port in the receiver’s settings (ultrafeeder usually uses 8080 or 8087) and enter the full address. Use the IP address rather than adsb-feeder.local and reserve it for the receiver in your router.
Tlačítko „Moje poloha“ ukáže jiné místo: The “My location” button shows a different place
Stránka zařízení běží na http://, a tam: The device page runs on http://, where the browser does not allow precise GPS location. The button therefore uses only an approximate location from the IP address, often the location of your internet provider. Refine it by clicking the map, dragging the marker or searching for an address.
Nejde se přihlásit do webového rozhraní: Cannot log in to the web interface
Podrž tlačítko BOOT 5 s, připoj se telef: Hold the BOOT button for 5 s, connect your phone to the WiFi “Letadla-XXXX” and open http://192.168.4.1 – the hotspot does not ask for a password. In the Login section tick “Remove password” and press Save (you will also see the saved user name there). The user name is not case-sensitive. After you set a new password, the page shows the user name to log in with.
Chci si nastavení zálohovat: I want to back up my settings
Na stránce Systém dej „Stáhnout zálohu“: On the System page click “Download backup” (optionally with WiFi and web passwords). You can upload the JSON file any time with “Restore from file”, even to another device; it then restarts.
Cena elektřiny se nenačte nebo chybí zít: The electricity price does not load or tomorrow is missing
Obrazovku je potřeba zapnout v sekci Obr: The screen has to be enabled in the Screens section. Prices are downloaded only after the time is synchronised. OTE publishes tomorrow’s prices around 13:00; until then a long press shows today. The status, including which source the data comes from, is on the System page in the Electricity price row. If one source fails, the device tries the other one by itself.
Na obrazovce počasí chybí některá hodnot: A value is missing on the weather screen
Ne každá stanice měří všechno: vítr, srá: Not every station measures everything: wind, precipitation or pressure may be missing. On the serial console (115200 baud) all available quantities with their codes are printed after each download. You can adjust the codes at the top of main.cpp if needed.
Barvy na displeji jsou obrácené nebo div: The colours on the display are inverted or odd
Některé moduly GC9A01 mají jinou inverzi: Some GC9A01 modules use a different colour inversion. In firmware/display.h set cfg.invert to false.
Displej svítí, ale je prázdný nebo bílý: The display is lit but blank or white
Firmware neběží. Nejčastěji byl nahraný: The firmware is not running. Most often firmware.bin was flashed instead of firmware-full.bin, or to an address other than 0x0. Another possibility is a wiring mistake: check CS, DC and RST.
Jak se podívat do sériové linky: How to look at the serial console
V esptool-js klikni na <b>Console</b>, z: In esptool-js click Console, choose 115200 and press RESET on the board. You will see the WiFi connection, hotspot status, number of aircraft, ČHMI values and the update check.
